title: Doctor / Forensics / Recover commands
body: GSD-2 ships `gsd doctor`, `gsd forensics`, `gsd headless recover` as first-class diagnostic commands for stuck/wedged runs. Compose has `compose doctor` for dep checks but not for active-build introspection. Add `compose forensics <feature-code>` (dump active-build state, last N journal entries, Stratum trace, hypothesis ledger if bug-mode) and `compose recover <feature-code>` (reconcile active-build with disk state, prompt to resume / abort / kill). Operator surface for IDEA-8 markers.
